verdict.rationale: AutoGen's code is hosted in a public GitHub repository (github.com/microsoft/autogen), and a community member points to the notebooks folder in that repo, so the source is readable. However, nothing in the evidence names the license or confirms it is an open-source license, which is half of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an open license (e.g. MIT/Apache LICENSE file), and documentation or independent confirmation of the licensing terms.
